title: Defensive line stats
intro: Pass rush and run defense up front. Pressure rate is pressures per opponent dropback from Pro Football Reference. No-blitz pressure rate counts only dropbacks where the defense rushed four or fewer, so it measures the front without help from blitzes; it comes from NFL Next Gen Stats tracking via nflverse; published for 2018–2025 so far, blank for this season until it is released. Rush yards over expected and 8+ box rate are Next Gen Stats weekly tracking. Yards before contact allowed is per running-back carry; stuffs are designed runs stopped for no gain or a loss.
